card.name: Digits just before a year
card.fires_on: The space or the first digit of a four-digit year in dates, such as after "in" or inside "2012" after a month and day. It also appears on the comma before a year.

modes.label: Space before a year
modes.description: The blank before a year after "in", as in founding or event dates.

modes.label: Inside a 20xx year
modes.description: The "0" within a year like 2012 in a dated post or article line.

modes.label: Comma before a year
modes.description: The comma between day and year in a full date.

card.plain: It fires while a year is being written out, just before or inside the year digits.
